Class InfoJsonValidator

java.lang.Object
de.christianmahnke.iiif.fliiifenleger.InfoJsonValidator
public final class InfoJsonValidator extends Object
Validates info.json documents against the bundled JSON Schemas for IIIF Image API 2 and 3.

Base schemas live in core/src/main/resources/schema/: image-api-2-info.json and image-api-3-info.json. Service extensions (C2PA, HDR, …) ship their own schema fragments in their modules (see ServiceExtension) which are composed with the V3 base schema via allOf; the V2 schema models extensions as plain URIs in the embedded profile supports list and rejects namespaced properties such as trustAnchor. On a core-only classpath (no extensions discovered) extension service entries validate as generic services.

Beyond structural validation, semantic rules that JSON Schema expresses poorly are checked by pluggable Validator implementations (discovered via ServiceLoader): core ships the generic IIIF rules, the extension modules own their service semantics (see Validator).

    • semanticChecks

      protected static List<String> semanticChecks(tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode node, ImageInfo.IIIFVersion version)
      Runs every discovered Validator accepting the effective version and merges their ValidationResults.
      Parameters:
      node - The parsed info.json document (a JSON object).
      version - The effective IIIF Image API version.
      Returns:
      The merged validator errors (without version information; the caller supplies its own detection result).
